name: 14.0 CONTENT PREVIEW - GUNS,GEAR,AMMO AND ATTACHMENTS ADDED
teaser: Includes Sig Spear/9A-91/VSK-94, attachments, helmets, barter items, ammo and clothing. (RPD is broken, armor plates not included)
description_html:
Huge thanks to SSH for helping out with some of the bundles and especially to Mighty_Condor for development work behind the tools and mod.ts used. Also thanks to whoever dumped the item stats and locales on the server.

Disclaimer!!! The bags and their layouts and some of the items are an approximations of how the actual item works in live.

DOES NOT CONTAIN ANY OF THE NEW SYSTEMS SUCH AS ARMOR PLATES/ZONES AND NEW RECOIL

All items are added only to the flea market.

Buy the 2 new sets of clothing from ragman.

Installation:

Extract folder in 7z file to your mods folder

The directory should look like this:

/user/mods/Guns Update 14.0/
/user/mods/y1400 items preview/

Licenses

Ported by PETTAN

Backend/mod.ts by Mighty_Condor - University of Illinois/NCSA Open Source License

Known Issues:

Does not work with anything that overhauls major systems.

The RPD/N is added but has BROKEN animations use at your own risk. RPD/N ADS is broken, you need to trigger an animation(sprinting/toggling tactical device/toggling between scopes) during ads/after ads to allow the character to fire the weapon.

Items are added to the closest existing mastery for now since I don’t know what the id/name of their exact mastery is.

Uninstalling:

If you want to remove the mod make sure to not have any of the added items in your profile before deleting the folder.
